subject: Monkey D. Luffy
continuity: One Piece manga through the end of Wano Country arc
intent: Produce a faithful playable Straw Hat unit using the current Manga Mayhem contract. Exactly three paths of five concrete cumulative purchases, legal maximum 5-2-0. Every purchase must change executable behavior. Source facts must be established by fresh research. Disclose numerical tuning, unlock schedules and bounded interpretations as game adaptations; distinguish omitted powers from implemented powers. This is a stationary tower encounter with caller-supplied enemy motion and ally injuries, not tower defensive combat or free unit movement. Avoid unsupported air-only target classes, tower HP, shields, taunt, or invented powers. If a source trait has no runtime representation, preserve it in an explicit omission rather than a fake stat bonus. Use the supported schema exactly, including resources, projectile flight, target geometry, statuses, and shared technique lifecycle. Balance is a later measured pass; prices are provisional. World units are shared across the crew: ordinary close contact roughly 8-18, stretched or ranged profiles roughly 30-60; do not treat these as canon measurements. Keep signatures recognizable and source-backed. Approved design direction: long-range direct melee contact using stretched fists, not traveling ammunition. Base Gum-Gum Pistol roughly 45 reach. The ONLY three upgrade paths are Conqueror Haki, Observation Haki, Armament Haki. Shared form access based on highest tier on ANY path: Gear Second at 1, Gear Third at 2, Gear Fourth variants Boundman/Snakeman/Tankman at 3, Gear Fifth at 5. Base is not Gear First. Provide different replacement attack profiles and a contextual Technique for these forms; research named moves. Gear II+III is a contextual Technique replacement after tier 2, not simultaneous forms. One shared bounded stamina resource, recovery in base, positive drain in Gears, reentry delay and shared Technique cooldown. Conqueror controls weak-willed stunnable enemies then coating; Observation detects concealed enemies and improves reach/targeting/cadence; Armament hardening, armor penetration, emission/internal damage. Explicitly disclose selectable Tankman without a feeding prerequisite as game adaptation, and bounded Fifth rubberization rather than unrestricted reality alteration. Preserve all these design decisions, research whether individual move names are supported. Supplemental research focus: Focus fresh source extraction on Wano Gear Fifth named techniques including Bajrang Gun, distinguishing post-Wano Dawn techniques that must be excluded, and documented Gear Second plus Gear Third combination technique. Retain claims only when supported by read source content; label missing facts as gaps. Do not infer game mechanics or numbers from canon.
